title: Abba bar Acha bar Salla of Kafri
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is the father of Rabbi Chiyya, of Aivu the father of Rav, of Chana the father of Rabbah, of Shila and of Marta. He is mentioned in Sanhedrin 5a concerning the lineage of his sons and family.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Sanhedrin 5a gives the father’s name as Abba bar Acha Karsalla of Kafri (אבא בר אחא כרסלא מכפרי), whereas Hyman’s heading has bar Salla. The family directions in Hyman’s notice are retained; the Rabbah named as Chana’s son is not identified with a different famous Rabbah here.

Sanhedrin 5a names Aivu, Chana, Shila, Marta and Rabbi Chiyya as sons of Abba bar Acha Karsalla of Kafri. Hyman’s bar Salla form and family directions are preserved without identifying the named Rabbah with another person.
